moments.title: Isaac and Sarah Harvey House
moments.text: An 1848 farmhouse on a hilltop facing the Springfield meetinghouse across the valley, from which Isaac and Sarah Harvey went in the fall of 1862 to see President Lincoln about emancipation.

moments.title: Caesar Creek Spillway and Fossil Bed
moments.text: The largest trilobite on display at the Smithsonian came out of Caesar Creek, and collectors here may keep what fits in the palm of a hand, found without tools.

moments.title: Miami White Brick Meetinghouse
moments.text: Waynesville's meetinghouse of 1811 has two doors and two equal sides, and a partition lowered on rope pulleys split it for the men's and women's business meetings.
